content:
The image shows a single mango leaf that is:
- Completely brown/desiccated — dead tissue throughout
- Shriveled and curled along its length
- Dark necrotic margins, particularly along the edges and tip
- No powdery coating, no sooty black surface, no discrete lesions

This pattern — tip and margin necrosis progressing to complete leaf death with curling/shriveling — is characteristic of **Die Back**, where the dieback of shoot tissue causes leaves to wither and die from the tip backward. Anthracnose would show more discrete dark lesions. Powdery Mildew would have white/gray powder. Sooty Mould would have a black sooty coating.
